name: ConversationList
description: Stacks chat messages in a scroller that follows new arrivals.

showAvatars.description: Show avatars for messages and typing indicators in this conversation

autoScroll.description: Auto-scroll behavior: true (always), false (never), or "smart" (only when near bottom)

onScrollTop.description: Callback when user scrolls to top (for loading history). Receives the scroll event.

loadingHistory.description: Show loading spinner at top when loading history

emptyState.description: Content to show when conversation is empty

scrollTopThreshold.description: Pixels from top to trigger onScrollTop

scrollBottomThreshold.description: Pixels from bottom for smart auto-scroll

when: Transcripts that should follow new arrivals
Paging back through older message history
Runs of messages grouped day by day
whenNot: Plain item lists with no chat context (use List)
guidelines: autoScroll="smart" follows only when the reader is already near the bottom
showAvatars={false} drops the avatar gutter and the inset that goes with it
Chrome stays on neutral surfaces; reserve accent for actions and semantic state
Implement onScrollTop to page in older messages
Your onScroll handler composes with the internal auto-scroll and history logic
Put a DateSeparator between messages from different days
accessibility: Uses proper ARIA roles for separators
Typing indicator uses a status role with an aria-label
Smooth scroll respects reduced motion preferences
Keyboard navigation works within scrollable container

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Three turns stacked in reading order.
examples.code:
<ConversationList>
  <Message role="user">
    <Message.Content>Hello!</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <Message role="assistant">
    <Message.Content>Hi there! How can I help you today?</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <Message role="user">
    <Message.Content>Can you explain React hooks?</Message.Content>
  </Message>
</ConversationList>

examples.name: With Date Separators
examples.description: A labelled rule marks where one day ends.
examples.code:
<ConversationList>
  <ConversationList.DateSeparator date={new Date(Date.now() - 86400000)} />
  <Message role="user">
    <Message.Content>A message from yesterday</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <ConversationList.DateSeparator date={new Date()} />
  <Message role="assistant">
    <Message.Content>And a message from today!</Message.Content>
  </Message>
</ConversationList>

examples.name: Without Avatars
examples.description: Turns sit flush when nothing needs an avatar gutter.
examples.code:
<ConversationList showAvatars={false}>
  <Message role="user">
    <Message.Content>Hello!</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <Message role="assistant">
    <Message.Content>How can I help?</Message.Content>
  </Message>
</ConversationList>

examples.name: With Typing Indicator
examples.description: Animated dots hold the reply's place before it lands.

examples.name: Loading History
examples.description: A spinner pins to the top while older turns load.
examples.code:
<ConversationList loadingHistory>
  <Message role="user">
    <Message.Content>This is the latest message</Message.Content>
  </Message>
</ConversationList>

examples.name: Empty
examples.description: A fresh conversation shows its placeholder instead of blank space.
examples.code:
<ConversationList
  emptyState={
    <EmptyState>
      <EmptyState.Title>No messages yet</EmptyState.Title>
      <EmptyState.Description>
        Ask a question to get started.
      </EmptyState.Description>
    </EmptyState>
  }
/>

relations.note: Show ThinkingIndicator at bottom while awaiting response
Typically paired with Prompt for input

propsSummary: showAvatars: boolean - show message and typing-indicator avatars (default: true)
onScrollTop: (event?) => void - callback for loading history (receives scroll event)
loadingHistory: boolean - show history loading spinner
